title: ExecutionProvenance
description: Provider-neutral record of how an execution was carried out: the target the outcome is attributed to, its declared locality, the configured and provider-reported model, every attempt, and why other candidates were rejected. Carried on TaskResult, on every StreamTerminalOutcome branch, and on IndeRunError. It reports what the engine observed and what providers declared or reported; it never infers a model or locality a provider did not state, and it never contains request content, credentials, or provider payloads.

schemaVersion.description: Contract schema version used to interpret this provenance record.

modelProfile.description: The model profile the request routed within; 'auto' when the request named none.

providerId.description: The target the outcome is attributed to: the provider that produced the result, the provider a stream had committed to when it ended, or the provider that was running when it was cancelled. Absent when no provider was reached or when every attempted provider failed before one was committed to.

locality.description: Where providerId declares it executes: 'on_device' for a local provider, 'edge', or 'cloud'. A declaration by the provider's descriptor, not a measurement. 'unknown' when providerId is absent.

configuredModel.description: The model providerId is bound to, as its descriptor declares it. Absent when the provider cannot name its model or no provider is attributed.

reportedModel.description: The model identifier the provider reported in its own response. Absent means the provider did not report one; it is never inferred from configuration.

attemptCount.description: How many providers were attempted. 0 when the request failed validation or routing, or was cancelled before any attempt started.

fallbackOccurred.description: Whether more than one provider was attempted (attemptCount > 1).

attempts.description: Every attempted provider, in attempt order, with how its attempt ended.

outcome.title: AttemptOutcome
outcome.description: 'succeeded' (produced the result or was committed to and completed), 'failed', or 'cancelled'.

errorClass.description: Normalized error class of a failed attempt.

routeRejections.description: Providers the route planner rejected before any attempt, with the normalized RoutePlan reason codes. Codes only: no provider-supplied messages.
